name: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Oil

faq.answer: The customer asks for one Shadow Oil delivered to the marked place, along with the writ itself.
The document notes at the bottom that it is transferable, so anyone holding it may make the exchange.
faq.q: Can someone else fulfill this writ?

faq.answer: The note directs delivery to the designated location marked upon your map, where payment awaits.

sections.body: A customer seeks a flask of Shadow Oil and offers payment upon arrival. You need only secure the requested draught, keep the contract in hand, and carry it to the designated drop. Because the agreement remains transferable, any bearer who produces the goods and the paper may claim the fee.
sections.title: A Trade in Shadow

summary: A faded order calls for a single flask of Shadow Oil to be brought to an appointed destination. The transferable contract promises payment to whoever arrives with the draught and paper in hand.
attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Oil
